items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Tommy Morton came to see me, say, Mario, would you give me a hand? I need a favor. I said, what's going on? I say, I manage a ballroom downtown called the ALMA DANCE STUDIOS Palladium Ballroom.

ctx.x: So we opened there. The man went crazy. He called me and said, Mario, as long as I own this club, this hotel, (inaudible). We make 20 seasons with our group, year after year, year after year, until we got of tired and didn't want to go back (inaudible).
